help.title: ❓ Help
help.text:
I'm a renovation estimator bot for quickly calculating the cost of renovation works.

📝 How to use:
1. Tap "New estimate"
2. Describe the works and specify the city
3. Get a ready estimate with price ranges
4. Edit or export to Word/PDF

🎁 30 days free, then 299 Stars/month.

Support: {support}
